title: Refund is a kobo short
description: Order K-1001: one T-shirt pack at ₦2,499.99, returned damaged. The customer was refunded ₦3,999.98 but expected ₦3,999.99 (₦2,499.99 plus the ₦1,500 delivery fee).

title: Customer refunded twice
description: Order K-1002 was refunded twice for the same shoes. The customer says the app froze and they tapped Submit again.

title: Return on day 14 rejected
description: Order K-1003 was delivered on 1 September. The customer asked to return it on 15 September, within the 14 days on our website, and was told it was outside the return window.

title: Order search shows other customers' orders
description: Typing ' OR '1'='1 into the support tool's email search returns every order in the system.

title: Refunds add up to more than the order
description: Order K-1005 was returned in two parts, both damaged. Each refund included the ₦3,000 delivery fee, so the customer got the fee back twice.

title: Server error for a missing order
description: Requesting a refund for an order that doesn't exist returns a 500 error instead of a clear message.
